$comment: Dot-segment removal per RFC 3986 §5.2.4 (URL-CANONICALIZATION.md §3.3.4 rule 3). Both ends resolve ./ and ../ before reaching the canonical bytes. The exact algorithm is RFC 3986's, applied verbatim; this vector pins a simple case.
name: dot-segments
scenario: Naive URL builder emits relative path components; both ends normalize
$comment_security: Dot-segment removal is REQUIRED, not optional. A naive proxy that resolves dot-segments and a naive P that doesn't would otherwise disagree, and the signature would fail. Both ends MUST apply the same RFC 3986 §5.2.4 algorithm.
